resources.string: Move your local data to a new phone over Wi-Fi
Move data to your new phone
Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi and sign in to the same Pixiv account. Data is encrypted and sent directly between the phones.
Sign in to Pixiv before starting a transfer.

App and download settings, muted items, search and browsing history, pinned tags and artists, your Watch Later list, saved features, your synonym dictionary, and saved accounts. Downloaded files, caches, and system folder permissions are handled separately.
Choose “Scan to receive” on the new phone. This one-time QR code expires in 2 minutes.
Send data to your new phone?
Check that both phones show the same pairing number. The backup includes saved accounts and app settings.
Scan the old phone’s QR code
Point your camera at the code on the old phone’s Phone transfer screen.
Check the pairing number on the old phone, then tap “Confirm and send”.
Keep both phones on Wi-Fi and stay on the transfer screen.
Your new phone has finished restoring. Your data is still available on this phone.
Local records have been merged and settings imported. Some settings take effect after you restart the app.
Could not connect over Wi-Fi. Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network and make sure it lets devices communicate.
Sign in to the same Pixiv account on both phones, then pair again.
The connection timed out. Generate a new QR code on the old phone.
The connection failed or was interrupted. Check Wi-Fi and available storage on both phones, then pair again.
The new phone could not restore this backup. Check available storage and update the app on both phones before trying again.
The old phone could not confirm the result. Check the transfer status on your new phone.
This code cannot be used for a transfer. Scan the QR code from the old phone’s Phone transfer screen.
Camera access is required to scan. If the permission prompt does not appear again, enable the camera in system settings.
Could not open the camera. Close other apps using it and try again.
